title: Cavern with an Underground Lake
name: scene_cavern_lake
scene_summary: One enormous natural cave seen from straight down onto its floor: wet grey stone, half of it filled by a still black underground lake crossed by a natural stone rib of pale rock.
render_details: Wet grey limestone seen from directly above, dark pooled water in the hollows, a wide sheet of still water so black it reflects nothing, broken stalagmite stumps as small round tops, thick rock columns as round grey tops with hard shadows beside them, one huge rounded boulder, loose scree, pale mineral streaking on the rock

rooms.label: Cavern Floor
rooms.description: One continuous cave floor of wet grey rock, uneven and streaked with pale mineral, with broken stalagmite stumps standing out of it. It is one open space with no built walls anywhere: the only edges are natural rock.

annotations.label: Black Lake
annotations.description: A wide sheet of absolutely still black water filling this whole rectangle from edge to edge, so dark it reflects nothing, its edge meeting the wet rock in a clean irregular line, with a few faint rings spreading on it here and there

annotations.label: Stone Rib
annotations.description: A narrow natural rib of pale rock crossing the black water from one shore to the other, uneven along its length and barely a stride wide at its narrowest, standing just clear of the surface with water on both sides of it

annotations.label: Far Shore
annotations.description: A wide flat shelf of dry pale rock on the far side of the water, ringed by fallen rock blocks

annotations.label: Great Boulder
annotations.description: One enormous boulder alone on the cave floor, seen from straight above as a rounded grey mass filling most of this rectangle, with loose scree scattered on the floor all round it

annotations.label: Pillar Maze
annotations.description: A close-set group of thick natural rock columns, seen from straight above as a scatter of rounded grey tops with hard shadows beside them, narrow winding gaps between them wide enough for one person

annotations.label: Rock Ledge
annotations.description: A raised shelf of dry rock, seen from straight above as a pale flat table of stone with a hard shadow line round its edge where it drops to the floor
